log.notes_to_self: Plan: kill all criminals daily (quick, afternoon only, so only day workers are ruled out) to reach the 4x multiplier from day 4 (44+ deaths in 5 days). Monitor pool and deaths_traced each day. If pool nears about 3000, reduce kills, prioritising criminals in places L may be unable to reach. Day 1: killed all 11.

STATE after day 2 decision: killed all 11 (10 quick + 1 timed, all afternoon; only day workers are ruled out, and that is already done, so pool is about 55k from routine alone). KEY RISK: L cannot reach 2 of 5 kinds (regional, sector, age, forum, foreign), so 3 are reachable. Each reachable kind, once L has 3 traced victims in it, cuts the pool by about 0.2-0.25. All three reachable kinds triggered gives about 55000*0.0156 = 860, or lower, which is under 1000, so I am caught and lose half. Two triggered gives about 3000-3500, which is safe. Successful traces only come from reachable kinds, so watch deaths_traced (T). Three triggers need T of about 9 or more, so days 2-3 are safe to kill everything. Pool drops by about x0.25 per trigger: 55k -> 14k (reads 10000) -> 3.4k (reads 3000) -> about 860 (caught). PLAN: from day 4, once T is 7 or more, or the pool shows 2 triggers (about 3000), stop killing in some kinds. Keep roughly 9 kills a day (national plus 4 kinds) so the 5-day window stays at 40 or more for 4x. Multiplier: 4x needs 40 or more deaths in the last 5 days, 2x needs 30 or more. Prefer to omit one kind entirely, 60% chance it is a reachable one, and pick docket (strongest 0.2 cut) or whichever kind seems riskiest. If the pool is stable at about 3000 for several days, stay with the 4-kind set. Never let the pool come near 1500 without cutting kills. Day 1: killed 10; day 2: killed 11. Press: after d1 pool 60000, T=2.

STATE after day 3 decision: killed 9 today (all quick, afternoon): national, foreign x2, forum x2, clips x2, North x2. Deliberately OMITTED docket (d3-2, d3-7). Rule: block is always afternoon, which rules out only day workers. Pool is about 55k from routine alone (shown as 60000). LOGIC: L cannot reach 2 of the 5 kinds, so 3 are reachable and only those give successful traces. Each triggered kind (3 traced victims in one place) cuts the pool by about x0.25 (docket x0.2). Three triggers give about 700-860, which is under 1000 and I get caught, losing half and all future points. Future points are worth about 900, so catastrophe avoidance beats a few points. Two triggers give about 3.4k, which is safe. Through day 2, T=6 traced, probably about 2 per reachable place. A place I did not kill in today cannot gain traces today. Pool was still 60000 after day 2, so no trigger yet. MULTIPLIER: 4x needs 40 or more deaths in the last 5 days, 2x needs 30 or more. Deaths so far: d1 10, d2 11, d3 9, so the window is 30 and today is 2x. Killing 9 a day (national + 4 places x2) keeps the 5-day window at 45, which is 4x. Killing 8 a day gives exactly 40. Never fall below an average of 8 a day. PLAN: read the day 3 press conference. If the pool has dropped once (about 14k), keep omitting docket and watch. If it shows two triggers (about 3000-3500), the third reachable kind is among the places that have NOT triggered, so omit the riskiest place(s) while still keeping at least 8 kills a day. Omitting 2 places gives 7 kills a day, which loses 4x, so avoid that unless the pool is near 1500. If the pool stays at 60000 with T rising slowly, keep omitting one place, and rotate which one only if pool evidence suggests a different place is the dangerous one. Triggered places are safe to keep killing in, and unreachable ones are also safe. Never let the pool near 1500 without cutting kills. History: d1 killed 10, d2 killed 11, d3 killed 9. Press: after d1 pool 60000 T=2, after d2 pool 60000 T=6.
